arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original DEADWALL source sprite, one complete isolated Bassin fermé — variante 1.
INPUTS: Image 1 is the authoritative geometry/layout reference rendered by the unchanged game public painter for this exact authored fixture, painter variant 1. Image 2 is MATERIAL AND PAINTERLY STYLE ONLY from the original game atlas; ignore its camera angles, other sprites, grid and background.
CAMERA AND SHAPE: strict orthographic overhead plan, looking vertically downward. Follow image 1 exactly: X points right and Y points down. Preserve its orientation, silhouette, footprint aspect ratio, part count, positions and occlusions. No tilted isometric view or tall exposed facade.
SUBJECT: One complete long rectangular neglected outdoor swimming basin viewed exactly from above, long axis VERTICAL. Closed means closed to public use; the quiet water is visible, with no cover or roof. Preserve the rectangular dark outer edge, pale grey-green stone/tile coping and RECTANGULAR muted dirty olive-green water surface. Preserve ONE fixed ladder at the RIGHT long edge in the LOWER half, exactly as image 1: two parallel rails extending leftward into the water and THREE short cross-rungs. Preserve TWO thin, faint, straight parallel lines running VERTICALLY along the water at the source positions. Preserve FIVE small dull olive residue clusters: three in a column on the right and two in a column on the left, following the exact canonical placement. Render residue naturally rather than as painted ellipses. Do not move the ladder to the upper half or turn the two vertical lines into horizontal lanes. Only the source-defined coping surrounds the water; no terrace, lawn, fence, furniture, people, swimmers, diving board, pump, active ripples, depth markings or water-service symbol.
AUTHOR DESIGN ENVELOPE: 8 m across X by 12 m along Y, separate maximum height 0.4 m; authored basin depth 1.4 m. These are game-author design values, not manufacturer measurements. Keep the existing metric proportions; do not redesign the object to fill the canvas.
MATERIALS: grounded serious post-apocalyptic game, restrained detailed hand-painted pre-rendered source art. Follow the canonical variant palette with weathered wood, dull metal and worn stone as applicable; modest grain, small scuffs and soft neutral overhead light. Keep major structural features readable. Idle and unattended, no invented damage or new activity.
OUTPUT: ONE whole object only on true transparent RGBA. Centre the complete silhouette with at least 12 percent clear transparent margin on every side. No crop, detached objects, external ground shadow, ground plane, background scene, UI, lettering, dimensions, logo or watermark. Preserve all thin components. This is a source-art proposal for later calibration, not a claim of metric or pixel-for-pixel certification.

inspection.canonical: Complete vertical rectangular basin inspected. Right-edge ladder sits in lower half, with two rails and three rungs. Two straight vertical pale water lines; five olive residues, three right and two left. Rectangular coping and water opening; no scene or cover.
inspection.style: Original Art157 yard atlas inspected. Weathered stone, muted water and subdued material rendering only; its sprite viewpoints and other subjects are not geometry references.
